notes.title: Please don't hurt me! - Aracore update 1.4
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/69b1a300422de51a94b3796e9c761793167d98a7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Additional mission added![/h1][p][/p][p]After analysing ongoing pilot feedback, Haaris has decided to take new pilots under his wing. After his scans revealed a potential asteroid strike on Ara base, Haaris now offers to take new pilots on a mining mission with the hopes of avoiding chaos![/p][list][*][p]Added a new mining mission![/p][list][*][p]After the tutorial stage, players may now opt to go on a new mission with Haaris[/p][/*][*][p]This mission allows players to skip the asteroid strike and clean-up missions[/p][/*][*][p]Players may choose the (more clearly labelled) more difficult mission if they're sadists[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added an 'engine power' key: hold for finer movement control[/p][/*][*][p]Added an in-game link to the DIscord channel: join if you want to get involved in the game![/p][/*][*][p]Updated dialogue[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Join the Discord![/h1][p]If you want to be involved in development, get access to the beta-version of the full game (now around 80% complete), and give your own suggestions, join the [url="https://discord.gg/bxkgn3nTVP"]El Crabo Grande Game Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h1]Next Update[/h1][p]Some players are having issues with sound. If you have no sound or no music (which is a terrible shame, as the music is awesome), please post in the discussion board or Discord and I'll find a fix, which may involve ripping out the current sound engine and replacing it.[/p][p][b]Any feedback on the changes is always welcome! [/b][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Added an 'engine power' key: hold for finer movement control
Added an in-game link to the DIscord channel: join if you want to get involved in the game!

notes.title: AraCore Astromining Ventures NextFest Demo 1.2 Update
notes.content: [p]Updated the demo to include some features of the full game:[/p][list][*][p]New game mode: 'Challenge mode' with 18 micro-missions to test your mining skills[/p][/*][*][p]New Game mode: 'Free Mode' with two large stages to explore [/p][/*][*][p]Both new game modes contain new ships and technologies for the player to experiment with[/p][/*][*][p]Input will default to gamepad or keyboard depending on what you press on the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Direct link to steam community to feedback added to menu menu and pause menu[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/bbd354ff1235dfc0813c0b183ed631783200e5d4.png"][/img][/p][p]New achievements have been added for completing all challenges![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/e41ef1edce81d22649071bac2cd2d80b043f3e37.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: - New game mode: 'Challenge mode' with 18 micro-missions to test your mining skills
- New Game mode: 'Free Mode' with two large stages to explore
- Both new game modes contain new ships and technologies for the player to experiment with
- Input will default to gamepad or keyboard depending on what you press on the main menu
- Direct link to steam community to feedback added to menu menu and pause menu
New achievements have been added for completing all challenges!

notes.title: AraCore Astromining Ventures Demo 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Updated the demo:
[list]
[*]Added a short tutorial stage for players to familiarise themselves with the drone controls before chaos kicks in
[*]Allowed player to skip tutorial, or just fail it and move on anyway
[*]Altered Stage 3 (Ice Breaker) end condition to include docking with surveyor ship
[*]Added new dialogue for several rare situations when the player does strange combitations of things
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/25ced15b89b8011ea867901ac62e94fe328dcc33.png[/img]

Fixed bugs relating to starting Stage 4 (Noble Pursuits) with only one drone
Fixed collision issues with grapple on some objects
